capabilities: Runs configured Codex actions on the active note
Creates a new Markdown file next to the note with the result
Configures actions with a name, model, and prompt
Signs in through ChatGPT and lists models
Retries failed saves with the already generated text
disambiguation: Despite the generic name, it is not a general action or automation panel; it only runs Codex CLI actions on the active note.
extras: Interface is Russian-only; requires desktop Obsidian 1.12.7+; tested on macOS with Codex CLI 0.171.0; usage limits and charges depend on the ChatGPT plan.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run a local Codex CLI action with a custom prompt on the current note and save the result as a new file.

relations.evidence: The plugin launches the local Codex executable directly as a child process.
Codex connects to OpenAI for sign-in, the model list, and generation.

requires.name: ChatGPT account with access to Codex

summary: Panel that runs configurable Codex CLI actions on the active Markdown note, generating new note files from custom prompts.
